summary: Full-stack test of Hera manifestation app. Backend: 21/21 pytest cases pass (auth 409/401/me, stats, affirmations today/affirm/generate AI, favorites CRUD, journal CRUD + user isolation, upload+download with cross-user 404 isolation, goals CRUD + achieved patch, coach SSE stream w/ delta+done + persistence, discover filter+detail+404, sessions list+detail+complete, premium activate MOCKED). Frontend (390x844): onboarding (3 slides -> auth), register/login, Today screen (affirmation text, affirm -> 'Affirmed today', favorite, AI generate replaces text in ~10s), Journal tab (new entry FAB -> journal-new form -> entry list), Vision Board segment (add goal -> preset image -> polaroid appears), Coach tab (prompt chip + send -> streamed personalized AI reply using user's goals), Discover (6 chips, 6 articles, article detail + back), Visualization (play -> breathing timer counts down with step text), Profile (stats, premium card -> subscribe -> PRO badge visible, saved affirmations list), Logout returns to auth screen. All testIDs match. AI responses personalized with user name and goals.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') - should migrate to lifespan context manager (not blocking, but will warn)
In server.py upload (line 446), extension parsing can fail if filename has leading dot; current logic is OK but a safer rsplit('.',1)[-1] with validation would be cleaner
Minor: GoalPatch allows updating title but endpoint test only exercises achieved; implementation correctly ignores None fields
Nice: all MongoDB ObjectId '_id' properly aliased via BaseDocument + populate_by_name; no leakage in responses
seed_data_creation: During testing: added a journal entry 'UI_test_entry' and incremented maya@hera.app streak to 1 via affirm; activated premium (is_premium=True) on maya@hera.app. Also created an ephemeral TEST_ user per pytest run (not cleaned up but prefixed TEST_).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Seed user maya@hera.app / hera1234 now has is_premium=true after this run (premium activate was called); Profile shows PRO badge. Note: goal-new testIDs use lowercase category (goal-category-career, not goal-category-Career). Discover chips use `discover-chip-{Category}` and articles use `discover-article-{id}`. Coach SSE emits data: {delta} then data: {done:true}. File download endpoint accepts token via ?token= query OR Authorization header. gpt-5.4 via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY responds in ~5-10s for coach/affirmation generation.
rca_of_issue: No bugs detected. One console 401 observed immediately after logout is expected (in-flight auth/me request after token cleared).
